jobs.title: Principal Branding Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

Role Description


The Principal Branding Engineer serves as a senior technical engineer within the Professional Services organization, responsible for driving the successful delivery of complex branding initiatives. This role combines advanced front\-end engineering expertise with strategic planning, ensuring scalable, accessible, and high\-quality career site branding solutions. The Principal Branding Engineer acts as a subject matter expert, mentors team members, establishes technical standards, and collaborates cross\-functionally to influence product and implementation strategies.


About Us:

When you join iCIMS, you join the team helping global companies transform business and the world through the power of talent. Our customers do amazing things: design rocket ships, create vaccines, deliver consumer goods globally, overnight, with a smile. As the Talent Cloud company, we empower these organizations to attract, engage, hire, and advance the right talent. We’re passionate about helping companies build a diverse, winning workforce and about building our home team. We're dedicated to fostering an inclusive, purpose\-driven, and innovative work environment where everyone belongs.
Responsibilities:

Technical Support

* Define and maintain reusable frameworks, templates, and components to enhance delivery efficiency and consistency.
* Provide technical oversight and guidance on branding implementations, ensuring adherence to established standards and best practices.
* Resolve advanced front\-end challenges involving styling, responsiveness, layouts, and integrations.


Solution Delivery

* Partner with Implementation Managers to scope, estimate, and plan high\-complexity branding projects.
* Ensure all career site implementations meet accessibility, performance, usability, and brand compliance standards.
* Conduct design and code reviews to maintain the quality and integrity of deliverables.
* Support escalations and provide technical expertise for critical customer initiatives.


Team Development \& Mentorship

* Mentor Senior Branding Engineers and Branding Engineers to enhance their technical capabilities and delivery confidence.
* Support onboarding, training, and competency development programs for the branding team.
* Promote a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and technical excellence.


Process Improvement \& Innovation

* Identify opportunities to improve tools, workflows, methodologies, and delivery practices.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that enhance branding capabilities and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to the development and evolution of branding standards and implementation frameworks.


Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration

* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Support, and Customer Success teams to align branding initiatives with business objectives.
* Influence technical and design decisions across multiple teams and projects.
* Represent the Branding function in strategic planning discussions and organizational forums.
* Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders through effective communication and consultation.


Qualifications:
* 8–12\+ years of progressive experience in front\-end development, branding engineering, or related technical disciplines.
* Expert\-level proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive web design principles, with a strong focus on delivering scalable and maintainable solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with CSS preprocessors such as SASS or Less, and a solid understanding of modern styling methodologies.
* Extensive experience working with front\-end frameworks and component libraries, including Angular, Bootstrap, and Material UI.
* Strong knowledge of Angular architecture, reusable component development, coding standards, and front\-end engineering best practices.
* Proficiency with version control systems and collaborative development workflows.
* Working knowledge of REST and SOAP APIs, with experience integrating front\-end applications with external services and platforms.
* Demonstrated understanding of Agile development methodologies, sprint planning, and project delivery practices within cross\-functional environments.
* Proven experience leading complex branding and front\-end initiatives, including mentoring engineers and providing technical direction to project teams.
* Experience collaborating with Scrum Masters and cross\-functional stakeholders to communicate sprint progress, delivery status, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
* Hands\-on experience reviewing and supporting Jenkins build and deployment pipelines, with an understanding of CI/CD concepts and deployment best practices.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with the ability to assess technical complexity, estimate effort, identify implementation risks, and recommend effective solutions.
* Ability to monitor delivery metrics and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance development efficiency, quality, and team productivity.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions and build strong working relationships across teams.

jobs.title: Oracle Fusion Product Owner - Redwood Transformation
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced **Oracle Fusion Product Owner** to lead the prioritisation, roadmap planning, and delivery alignment for Oracle Fusion Redwood adoption across multiple Fusion modules.

Key Responsibilities:

* Define, prioritise, and manage Redwood features and enhancement requirements across Oracle Fusion modules.
* Interpret Oracle Fusion Redwood assessment findings and translate them into a clear roadmap, phased delivery plan, and actionable workplan.
* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring priorities align with business value, technical feasibility, risk, and delivery timelines.
* Work with business stakeholders to gather, clarify, and document requirements, pain points, process gaps, and desired future\-state outcomes.
* Map current and future\-state business processes across relevant Oracle Fusion modules.
* Collaborate with functional consultants, technical leads, engineers, testers, and service delivery teams to ensure requirements are understood and delivered effectively.
* Facilitate workshops, requirement sessions, playback discussions, prioritisation meetings, and stakeholder updates.
* Support impact assessment for Redwood adoption, including business process changes, user experience impacts, customisation considerations, testing needs, and change readiness.
* Ensure delivered features meet business acceptance criteria and support successful SIT/UAT activities.
* Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and decisions clearly to stakeholders and project leadership.
* Support change management and user adoption planning by helping define business impacts, training needs, and readiness considerations.

**Mandatory Skills and Experience:**

* Strong experience as a **Product Owner, Business Product Lead, Functional Lead, or Senior Business Analyst** within Oracle Fusion Cloud projects.
* Hands\-on or strong working knowledge of **Oracle Fusion Cloud** across one or more modules such as SCM, Procurement, Order Management, Manufacturing, Inventory, Supply Chain Planning, CX Service, Finance, or HCM.
* Ability to define and prioritise **Oracle Redwood features** across Fusion modules.
* Experience interpreting **Oracle Fusion Redwood assessment outputs** and converting them into a practical roadmap, prioritised backlog, and delivery workplan.
* Strong capability in **business process mapping, requirement gathering, and requirement translation**.
* Experience working with cross\-functional delivery teams, including business users, functional consultants, technical engineers, testers, project managers, and service delivery coordinators.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and influencing skills.
* Ability to balance business priorities, technical constraints, delivery timelines, and user experience outcomes.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery practices, backlog management, user stories, acceptance criteria, and sprint planning.
* Experience supporting SIT, UAT, defect triage, and business acceptance activities.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field; equivalent project experience may be considered.
* Proven experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation, enhancement, migration, or transformation projects.
* Demonstrated experience creating product roadmaps, prioritised backlogs, business requirements, process maps, and delivery plans.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Agile, Scrum, Product Owner, Oracle Fusion, or ERP\-related certifications are advantageous but not mandatory.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in cross\-functional teams
* Oracle Cloud certifications (preferred)
* Familiarity with Agile development methodologies (preferred)

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI/ML
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.
* Experience with Generative AI, Generative AI Agent, Natural Language Processing, Large Language Model.
* Experience implementing multi\-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, or Google’s Agent Development Kit (ADK)) and patterns like ReAct, self\-reflection, and hierarchical delegation.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with Low\-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) or Supervised Fine\-Tuning (SFT) and reasoning.
* Experience in designing algorithms that programmatically truncate, summarize, or extract semantic milestones from a running conversation log.
* Experience in track agent trajectories and implement Large Language Model (e.g., Phoenix, LangSmith). Experience in Safety and Compliance like Prompt injection mitigation, sandboxed code execution etc
* Experience in ReAct, Tree of Thoughts and Plan\-and\-Solve loops, Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs).
* Experience in Bias\-Variance tradeoff, Overfitting versus Underfitting, practical techniques to fix
* Experience in designing and implementing scalable AI solutions and rolling out AI and agentic solutions for Global Enterprises.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



Welcome to the AI Garage, the innovation engine within Google’s POp’sEngineering. We solve complex HR technology challenges by deploying advanced Agentic AI and ML into critical user experiences. Using an agile garage model, our multi\-disciplinary squads in India balance rapid innovation with engineering excellence to scale autonomous solutions. We are committed to building robust, empathetic, and responsible Artificial Intelligence (AI) that adheres to strict privacy and legal standards.
  

  

In this role, you will help us shape a more connected and productive future for all Google employees. You will have a keen interest in developing large\-scale agentic systems and possess technical expertise in Artificial Intelligence and machine learning.


At Corp Eng, we build world\-leading business solutions that scale a more helpful Google for everyone. As Google’s IT organization, we provide end\-to\-end solutions for organizations across Google. We deliver the right tools, platforms, and experiences for all Googlers as they create more helpful products and services for everyone. In the simplest terms, we are Google for Googlers.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) systems and Agentic solutions in the HR domain. Drive engineering excellence for the AI Garage team.
* Provide technical leadership in regards to immediate and complex technical problems to leads of associated teams.
* Influence and design and build scalable Agentic systems in HR domain.
* Collaborate with AI Garage Leads (e.g., Engineering Managers, Product Managers and AI strategist) and stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into technical solutions.
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest trends in Agentic and AIML engineering.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer 1(Java-Angular)
jobs.description:
**Join the Team Modernizing Medicine**


At **ModMed**, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: **we hired doctors and taught them how to code.** This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI\-enabled, specialty\-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care.

**A Culture of Excellence**


When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award\-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500\+ passionate problem\-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes:

* **Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work**
* **2025 Globee Business Awards:** Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year”
* **2025 Black Book Awards:** Ranked \#1 EHR in 11 Specialties
* **Florida Venture Forum:** Venture\-Backed Company of the Year


We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started.

**Ready to modernize medicine with us?**

**Job Description Summary:**


Our Mission \& Vision


At ModMed, we are placing doctors and patients at the center of care through an intelligent, specialty\-specific cloud platform. We envision a world where the software we build increases medical\-practice success and improves patient outcomes.


If you want to **align your passion with purpose** and build code that genuinely **does good**, you’ve found your next home.


 The Role: How You’ll Make an Impact


We are looking for a collaborative, growth\-minded **Java Full\-Stack Engineer** with strong **Angular** expertise. In this role, you won't just write code—you will **innovate boldly, then make things happen**. You will own features end\-to\-end, ensuring our platform is deeply intuitive, highly performant, and ultimately **saves time** for the healthcare providers who rely on us every day.

### **What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities):**

* **Create Customer Delight:** Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable cloud applications using Java (Spring Boot) and Angular that make a doctor's day\-to\-day seamless.
* **Think Big:** Participate in architectural discussions, bringing forward\-thinking ideas to scale our specialty\-specific platform.
* **Collaborate \& Connect:** Work closely with UX designers, product managers, and fellow engineers in an agile environment to turn complex healthcare workflows into elegant digital solutions.
* **Drive Excellence:** Write clean, well\-tested, and maintainable code. Lead code reviews and mentor junior developers, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can grow.
* **Have Fun \& Do Good:** Bring your authentic self to a team that celebrates diverse perspectives, tackles big challenges together, and enjoys the journey along the way.


️ What You Bring to the Team


We know that great talent comes in many forms. If you meet most of these qualifications and are excited about our mission, we encourage you to apply!

### **Technical Toolkit:**

* **Backend Mastery:** Strong experience with Java (Java 11\+ preferred) and the Spring Ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data).
* **Frontend Expertise:** Solid experience building modern, responsive user interfaces using Angular (or modern TypeScript frameworks with a willingness to specialize in Angular).
* **Database \& Cloud:** Familiarity with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred).
* **API Design:** Experience designing and consuming secure, high\-performance RESTful APIs.
* **Testing Culture:** Commitment to automated testing (JUnit, Mockito, Jasmine/Karma, or Cypress).

### **Mindset \& Culture Fit:**

* A passion for problem\-solving and a desire to improve the healthcare landscape.
* Strong communication skills with an empathetic, team\-first attitude.
* An agile mindset—comfortable iterating quickly to deliver value.


 What’s In It For You?

* **Purpose\-Driven Work:** The opportunity to build software that directly impacts patient outcomes and medical\-practice success.
* **Growth \& Learning:** Dedicated time and resources for continuous professional development.
* **Inclusive Culture:** A vibrant, welcoming environment where unique backgrounds and ideas are celebrated.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Competitive salary, robust health/wellness benefits, flexible PTO, and a work\-life balance that allows you to *have fun* outside of work.

**ModMed is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, or status as an individual with a disability.

***ModMed Benefits Highlight:*** At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits:

* Meals \& Snacks: Enjoy complimentary office lunches \& dinners on select days and healthy snacks delivered to your desk,
* Insurance Coverage: Comprehensive health, accidental, and life insurance plans, including coverage for family members, all at no cost to employees,
* Allowances: Annual wellness allowance to support your well\-being and productivity,
* Earned, casual, and sick leaves to maintain a healthy work\-life balance,
* Bereavement leave for difficult times and extended medical leave options,
* Paid parental leaves, including maternity, paternity, adoption, surrogacy, and abortion leave,
* Celebration leave to make your special day even more memorable, and company\-paid holidays to recharge and unwind.

City: Hyderabad
State/Province: Telangana
Posting Start Date: 6/15/26
Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future\-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.
Job Description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Role Purpose**

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters


**͏**
-----

**Do**

1\. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software


* Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
* Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
* Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
* Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
* Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
* Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
* Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities
**͏**
-----

2\. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development


* Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
* Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
* Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
* Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
* Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
* Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
* Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
* Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
* Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
* Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders
**͏**
-----

3\. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution


* Capturing all the requirements and clarifications from the client for better quality work
* Taking feedback on the regular basis to ensure smooth and on time delivery
* Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
* Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software\-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
* Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
* Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
* Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e\-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
* Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally
**͏**
-----

**Deliver**

**No.** **Performance Parameter** **Measure**  

1\. Continuous Integration, Deployment \& Monitoring of Software 100% error free on boarding \& implementation, throughput %, Adherence to the schedule/ release plan
  

2\. Quality \& CSAT On\-Time Delivery, Manage software, Troubleshoot queries, Customer experience, completion of assigned certifications for skill upgradation
  

3\. MIS \& Reporting 100% on time MIS \& report generation  

  

Mandatory Skills: Salesforce QA Automation .  

Experience: 5\-8 Years .  

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

**Product Safety – Senior Manager**
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad, India
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a Senior Manager in Product Safety, you will supervise and coordinate SAP EHS/S4HANA system and data management activities, ensuring compliance with global chemical and transport regulations. You will oversee hazard classifications, author Safety Data Sheets (SDS), and manage technical tools and interfaces within SAP. This role is pivotal in maintaining data integrity, monitoring regulatory changes, and providing hazard communication to support Lonza’s global operations and marketability.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* System \& Data Management: Supervise and coordinate SAP EHS/S4HANA system activities, ensuring functionality, data integrity, and compliance.
* Process Optimization: Evaluate and implement improvements at the intersection of SAP EHS users and IT topics, documenting processes and innovative solutions.
* Hazard Classification: Perform hazard classifications according to GHS, Dangerous Goods, and local regulations to ensure safe market entry of products.
* Transport Safety: Analyze and communicate transport hazards across all routes; maintain IATA DGR certification for classification.
* SDS \& Label Management: Author and manage regionally compliant SDS and label elements for applicable products using SAP EHS/S4HANA.
* Regulatory Documentation: Ensure provision of mandatory documents such as SDS, label information, DG classifications, and marketability reports.
* System Tools \& Updates: Establish and update user tools (expert rules, SDS templates, WWI templates, multilingual phrases), monitor data quality, and provide training.

jobs.title: Principal Product Designer
jobs.description:
What You'll Do
   

  

* Own the design vision and interaction architecture for a product area: setting direction, defining patterns, and ensuring coherence across features, releases, and teams.
* Lead end\-to\-end design from ambiguous problem spaces through shipped outcomes. You frame the problem, align stakeholders, design the solution, and measure whether it worked.
* Solve complex, cross\-functional product challenges with strategic foresight. You see the second\-order effects of design decisions and plan for them.
* Partner with Product and Engineering leadership as a strategic equal, influencing roadmap direction, investment priorities, and architectural trade\-offs.
* Drive design quality and consistency across your product area through critique, reviews, and direct contribution. You hold the bar and raise it.
* Lead design collaboration across teams, connecting your product area's patterns to the global design system and to adjacent product surfaces.
* Mentor senior and mid\-level designers. You shape how they think about problems, not just how they execute solutions.
* Bridge product strategy and design investment. You translate business goals into design direction and advocate for design\-informed decisions at the organizational level.


 What You Bring
   

  

* 8\+ years of product design experience, with a portfolio that demonstrates strategic thinking, systems\-level craft, and shipped impact in enterprise or B2B SaaS.
* Proven ability to own design direction for a product area: setting vision, making trade\-offs, and aligning cross\-functional stakeholders around a design point of view.
* Mastery of complex enterprise interaction design: systems of workflows, data\-dense operational interfaces, role\-based experiences, and cross\-product patterns.
* Strong Figma proficiency and deep fluency with design systems: not just using components, but understanding token architecture, governance, and how systems scale across frameworks.
* AI fluency that goes beyond tools. You shape how your team uses AI in the design process. You understand the architecture layer, agents, protocols, context\-aware systems, well enough to design for AI\-native products, not just with AI tools. You model the quality judgment your team needs: when AI accelerates the work, when it flattens it, and how to tell the difference.
* Strategic communication. You influence cross\-functional direction, present to senior leadership, and your design rationale holds up under organizational scrutiny.
* A track record of elevating teams: through mentorship, quality standards, and leading by example in how you frame problems and hold craft accountable.


 What Could Set You Apart
   

  

 At this level, strong craft, systems thinking, and user empathy are assumed. What separates candidates is the depth of their perspective on where design is going, and their willingness to move there before the industry catches up.
   

  

* Hands\-on practice with vibe coding or agent\-assisted development at a level where you can build functional prototypes, validate ideas in code, and demonstrate concepts that would otherwise take weeks to spec and hand off. You use these tools to think, not just to produce.
* Deep understanding of AI infrastructure as it relates to product design: protocols like MCP, agent orchestration, tool\-use patterns, context management. You can design experiences for systems where AI agents act on behalf of users, and you understand the trust, control, and transparency patterns that requires.
* A developed philosophical perspective on what AI changes about the design discipline. You think about what taste, craft, and originality mean when generation is commoditized. You have a point of view on where human judgment remains irreplaceable, and you can articulate it. This isn't academic for you. It shapes how you lead.
* A pragmatic, experimental disposition. You ship to learn. You fail fast and extract signal from failure. You don't wait for organizational permission to test an idea, and you create the conditions for your team to do the same.
* Experience designing for industries like manufacturing, distribution, supply chain, or retail operations, or in similarly complex, operationally critical domains.


 Why Epicor
   

  

 Epicor powers the essential industries that keep the world moving: manufacturing floors, distribution centers, supply chains, and retail operations. As we accelerate investments in AI, platform modernization, and cross\-product unification, design leadership becomes the difference between software that reacts to the market and software that defines it.
   

  

 Joining Epicor means you'll own design direction for products that run real operations at scale, on a team where AI\-native practice is the standard, craft is respected as leadership, and the problems are hard enough to be worth your time.
   

  

**About Epicor**
 At Epicor, we’re truly a team. Join 5,000 talented professionals in creating a world of better business through data, AI, and cognitive ERP. We help businesses stay future\-ready by connecting people, processes, and technology. From software engineers who command the latest AI technology to business development reps who help us seize new opportunities, the work we do matters. Together, Epicor employees are creating a more resilient global supply chain.
   

  

**We’re Proactive, Proud, Partners.**
 Whatever your career journey, we’ll help you find the right path. Through our training courses, mentorship, and continuous support, you’ll get everything you need to thrive. At Epicor, your success is our success. And that success really matters, because we’re the essential partners for the world’s most essential businesses—the hardworking companies who make, move, and sell the things the world needs.

jobs.title: Configuration Sr. Associate – Tulip
jobs.description:
At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life\-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.
  
  

**About the Technology Organization:**    
  
Technology at Lilly builds and maintains capabilities using cutting edge technologies like most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Technology at Lilly is that we create new possibilities through tech to advance our purpose – creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, like data driven drug discovery and connected clinical trials. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver innovative solutions in every area of the enterprise.   
  
  
  
**About the Business Function:**   
  
From molecule to market, Global Manufacturing plays an important role in every step along a product’s lifecycle. Most of our customers never see the scientific and technical resources behind our medicines. But customers experience, every day, the performance of our high\-quality products and global supply network.   
  
Global Manufacturing comprises a core group of functions that contribute to the production and supply of high\-quality products: Engineering; Manufacturing Information \& Control Systems; Quality \& Labs, Technology Services/Manufacturing Science; Global Health, Safety and Environment; and Global Supply Chain.  
  
  

**Job Title:** Configuration Sr. Associate – Tulip
  
  

 
  
The Configuration Sr. Associate – Tulip will support the development, configuration, and localization of global manufacturing applications built on the Tulip platform. This entry\-level role sits within a global program focused on eliminating paper\-based manufacturing processes. A successful candidate will contribute across the full delivery lifecycle — from requirements and process mapping through configuration, validation, site deployment, and ongoing support — and will bring a collaborative spirit, a continuous improvement mindset, and the drive to deliver higher\-quality results faster.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

**What you will be doing:**  

Global App Development \& Configuration
  
  

* Lead product strategy and application roadmap development in accordance with business value and program priorities.
* Design and configure Tulip global applications/app templates and ensure Lilly's global configuration standards for Tulip and regulatory\-compliant development practices are followed through peer code review.
* Drive localization of global app templates at manufacturing sites, working closely with site teams and global process owners to adapt applications to local needs while maintaining global alignment.
* Design and document application workflows, UI components, triggers, connectors, and integrations.
* Follow version\-control and change management practices for all configuration artifacts.
* Identify gaps/risks and appropriate mitigation to ensure timely delivery of releases.


Process Alignment \& Requirements
  
  

* Participate in requirement discovery sessions with sites, process owners, and business stakeholders to clarify needs and translate them into configuration requirements.
* Create and maintain process flow maps and app design documentation.
* Conduct application demos for site teams and leadership as part of deployment and change management activities.


Quality, Validation \& Compliance
  
  

* Perform all development activities in accordance with GxP and data integrity principles.
* Assist in validation process including documentation of configuration specifications and test scripts, including efforts to automate creation of these artifacts.
* Lead in cahnge control, release management, and deployment activities to maintain validated application state.


Support \& Platform Operations
  
  

* Resolve L2/L3 support tickets related to Tulip applications; escalate appropriately and contribute to knowledge base documentation as needed.
* Participate in regression testing, platform upgrades, and patch activities as needed.
* Identify recurring issues and propose process or configuration improvements.


Innovation \& Platform Evolution
  
  

* Lead developer experience initiatives, including AI\-assisted development and automation tooling.
* Lead efforts to identify and build integrations, data products, and AI/automation use cases that advance the program's paperless manufacturing goals.
* Proactively challenge current approaches to find better, faster, and higher\-quality ways of working.


Collaboration \& Growth
  
  

* Work as an active and contributing member of a truly global team — collaboration and team contribution are core expectations, not optional.
* Collaborate with other team members, including fellow Configurators, Business Process Architects, and business stakeholders to deliver outcomes under guidance.
* Demonstrate a growth mindset — pursue training, platform certifications, and best\-practice adoption within the Tulip ecosystem.


**How you will succeed:**  

* Learn and consistently apply Lilly's Tulip configuration standards and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Deliver accurate, well\-documented configuration work with strong attention to detail.
* Contribute reliably to support operations and site localization activities.
* Build technical capability in integrations, automation, and AI tooling through mentorship and hands\-on practice.
* Show up as a team player — proactive, communicative, and invested in shared outcomes.

Tracks and reports on key quality metrics, defect trends, automation ROI, and team productivity indicators. Proactively learns and applies new tools, techniques, and programming languages such as Go, Rust, JavaScript, Python, or other OOP languages. Leads the design of robust, scalable, and maintainable test automation frameworks for web, mobile, API, and backend testing. Contributes to AI\-based application testing, including LLM evaluation and validation using RAGAS and related frameworks. Implements performance and load testing strategies using JMeter to ensure system reliability and scalability. Drives cloud\-based testing initiatives, utilizing AWS, Kubernetes, and Docker for managing test environments. Process Improvement \& Quality Advocacy
  
  

Champions quality process improvements and ensures the team understands the trade\-offs and benefits of various testing approaches. Implements best practices in quality engineering, ensuring testing processes align with industry standards and compliance requirements. Promotes a quality\-first mindset across engineering and product teams, ensuring reliability, performance, and scalability are prioritised. Mentorship \& Knowledge Sharing
  
  

Supports and mentors junior and mid\-level QA engineers, providing guidance on test automation, performance testing, and CI/CD integration. Reviews test automation architectures, frameworks, and scripts, ensuring best practices are followed. Innovation \& Thought Leadership
  
  

Promotes and implements new and innovative testing…

jobs.description:

 The role will cover the active governance and technical ownership of solutions in the area of responsibility (e.ge. SAP Finance Core/Template governance) working together with Business and technical delivery teams to shape, prioritize and realize technical evolution. Developing and shaping technology direction, strategy, roadmap for applications in alignment with BPO, the overall SAP Finance strategy in cooperation with the relevant platform and architecture teams is a key component of the role.
   

  

 Major Accountabilities
   

  

* Act as primary Business Partner for Finance function in ‘‘Record To Report’, Product Cost Accounting, Overhead Cost Controlling. Foster best practice application in Business process and technology solution design
* Act as technical solution owner, as owner of technical core/template design of predominantly SAP based functionalities in R2R (General FI/CO, AA, PC, OM, integration to AR/AP, Inventory Accounting, parallel accounting and valuation, local and global accounting and reporting requirements), Product Cost Accounting (product cost planning, cost object controlling).

* Partner with other Technology teams for demand and user requirement analysis, evaluate solutions and drive the preparation of solution proposal including effort and cost estimates.
* Ensure on time, within budget and quality delivery of portfolio in a compliant manner in line with Business expectations and Technology strategy in collaboration with delivery organizations
* Own the design of innovative, fit\-for\-purpose, reusable and scalable functionality in area of responsibility and steer deployment with delivery teams following Business priorities to generate the desired Business value and impact
* Establish governance structure for service delivery (projects, enhancements, operations) with right stakeholder representation in area of area of responsibility.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams, to drive service delivery activities and resolve integration challenges effectively.
* Identify potential risks and issues related to applications integration, implementing proactive mitigation strategies to minimise impact on service delivery
* Facilitate clear communication between technical teams, business units, and external partners to ensure alignment and successful adoption of the integrated solution.


 Ideal Background
   

  

**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology Business Administration, or related field; (Master’s degree is preferred) or adequate/comparable alternative education/documented experience
* Certification in SAP Finance modules or proven/documented expertise in SAP Finance and Controlling modules (ECC / S/4HANA) required.
* Education/certification/proven expertise in Financial and Management accounting principles and processes beneficial.


**Languages**
* Fluent English required (oral and written)


**Experience And Skills**
* 10\+ years of experience in design, configuration, usage of SAP Finance/Controlling modules in multinational organizations
* Sound knowledge of SAP Finance transactional and analytics landscape, SAP platforms and applications and integrations to industry leading non SAP products in Finance area
* Documented experience in SAP functional areas of R2R (GL, AA, AR/AP, bank accounting), parallel valuation, profit centre accounting, overhead cost controlling (CO\-OM) incl. corresponding finance master data setup, product cost accounting (CO\-PC) and related financial planning processes
* Good leadership, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Proven ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and drive change and innovation.
* Experience in SAP Core/Template governance and working in diverse cultural environments.
* Experience with ITIL frameworks and other service management methodologies.

 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100\+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible\-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

**Join us!**

The Senior Analyst is a hands\-on contributor responsible for developing and maintaining commercial BI dashboards and analytics solutions using Power BI and SQL. The role translates business requirements into accurate KPIs, reports, and datasets while ensuring strong data quality and governance.  

  

The position also supports AI\-enabled and conversational reporting initiatives by preparing and validating datasets and assisting with natural\-language analytics capabilities.
### **About the Role**

**Business Analyst – Conversational Reporting \& Analytics**

**Role Overview**


The Business Analyst – AI\-Enabled Reporting \& Analytics is a hands\-on individual contributor responsible for building, maintaining, and enhancing commercial reporting and analytics solutions. The role focuses on delivering accurate, timely, and high\-quality BI reports and datasets, while supporting foundational AI\-enabled and conversational reporting capabilities.


The Senior Analyst works closely with Managers and Senior Analysts to translate business requirements into dashboards, datasets, and analytical outputs, ensuring adherence to analytics standards, data governance, and quality expectations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Commercial Reporting \& Analytics Execution**

* Develop and maintain commercial performance reports supporting Sales, Marketing, and Commercial Operations.
* Translate clearly defined business requirements into KPIs, dashboards, and analytical outputs.
* Support recurring performance reviews by delivering accurate and well\-documented analytics.

**2\. BI Development \& Dashboard Build**

* Build and enhance Power BI/Angular reports and dashboards, including:
	+ Report layouts and visual design
	+ DAX measure development under guidance
	+ Dataset usage and basic performance optimization
* Apply standardized KPI definitions, metrics, and reporting templates.
* Validate reports for accuracy, usability, and consistency.

 **3\. Analytics Data Preparation**

* Develop and maintain analytics datasets using:
	+ SQL\-based transformations
	+ Basic dimensional and semantic modeling concepts
* Support data pipelines and refresh processes in:
	+ Databricks and/or Dataiku
	+ Cloud\-based analytics platforms
* Partner with Managers to identify and resolve data quality issues.

**4\. Performance Analysis \& Insights Support**

* Perform standard performance analyses, including:
	+ Sales, campaign, and activity performance tracking
	+ Trend and variance analysis
* Prepare data summaries, charts, and supporting analysis for stakeholder presentations.
* Document assumptions, calculations, and data limitations clearly.

**5\. AI\-Enabled \& Conversational Reporting (Support Role)**

* Support AI\-enabled and conversational analytics initiatives by:
	+ Preparing and validating datasets used for conversational reporting
	+ Testing and validating chatbot or natural\-language query outputs
* Assist with building basic natural\-language reporting views under defined frameworks.
* Ensure outputs are accurate, traceable, and compliant with reporting standards.

**6\. Stakeholder \& Team Collaboration**

* Work with Managers to support day\-to\-day analytics requests.
* Participate in requirement discussions and clarification sessions.
* Collaborate with Analysts and peer Senior Analysts to ensure delivery consistency.

**7\. Quality, Governance \& Documentation**

* Follow established analytics development, documentation, and validation standards.
* Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory requirements.
* Contribute to documentation, reusable assets, and reporting best practices.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Economics, or related field
* Master’s degree preferred

**Experience**

* 3 – 6 years of experience in BI, reporting, or commercial analytics
* Hands\-on experience developing dashboards and analytics deliverables
* Exposure to pharmaceutical or life sciences commercial analytics preferred
* Experience working in structured, regulated environments is a plus

**Technical Skills**

**Required**

* Hands\-on experience with Power BI/Angular (report development, visuals, basic DAX)
* Strong SQL skills for data extraction and transformation
* Experience working with analytics datasets and reporting models
* Familiarity with commercial performance data (sales, marketing, field activity)
* Strong attention to data quality and detail

**Desired**

* Exposure to AI\-enabled or conversational reporting concepts
* Basic familiarity with natural\-language querying or AI\-assisted analytics
* Python exposure for analytics or automation
* Experience with Databricks, Dataiku, or cloud analytics platforms

**Preferred**

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure automation

 That is the qualifying condition for this role. Everything else in this document is for people who pass that bar.
 



 If you do not pass it, no amount of seniority, brand\-name companies, or AI\-adjacent leadership experience makes up for it. We will know within ten minutes of an interview. Save us both the time.
 



 If you do pass it, this is the role you have been waiting for.
 



  





**The bet** 




 Every fintech in India is shipping an AI feature. We are building the AI company.
 



  





 Multiple production agents are already live at Jupiter, doing real work every day across the business, internal and customer\-facing. They were built solo at the leadership level because the role we are now hiring did not yet exist in Indian fintech. It does now.
 



  





 The thesis is straightforward and large. Every customer gets an agent advocate. Every employee gets an agent peer. The agents talk to each other through a shared trust and tool layer, composing into answers and actions no single agent could deliver. The competitive moat is not any one agent. It is the topology between them. The company that nails this owns the next decade of fintech. We intend to be that company.
 



  





**The role** 




 You will own the AI product surface end to end.
 



 Customer\-facing agents that change how millions of users experience Jupiter. Internal agents that act as peer colleagues to humans across PM, CX, ops, and analytics. The composition layer that lets them work together. The next surface, as the fleet grows.
 



 You will set what each agent does, how it sounds, how it grounds in reality, what it refuses to do, and how it calls other agents to do things it cannot do alone. You will be in the prompts. You will be in the thumbs\-down comments. You will be in the tool definitions. You will be in the eval data.
 



  





 If “Director” makes you think of OKR templates and quarterly roadmap decks, this is not your role. If it makes you think “I finally get to build the thing I have been thinking about for two years,” read on.
 



  





 The team you’ll work with Small. Young. Fast. Default\-AI.
 



  





 Most of the people you will work with on this are in their twenties or early thirties. They came up after the LLM wave broke, they reach for an agent before they reach for a spec, and they have shipped more than people twice their age. The cadence is daily. The defaults are “build it yourself, ship it tonight, fix it tomorrow.” Meetings are short. Documents are shorter.
 



  





 The right hire treats this as a feature, not a compromise. You will be the most senior person in the room and you will not act like it. You will move at the pace they move, and you will earn their respect by shipping alongside them, not by holding office hours.
 



  





 If you have spent the last few years building scaffolding around yourself, you will struggle here. If the thought of working shoulder to shoulder with a 26\-year\-old who is faster than you at half the things you do makes you nervous, this is not the role. If it sounds like the most fun you could be having, read on.
 



  





**What makes this different from the same title anywhere else** 




 The scope is the company, not a feature. Most AI product roles in fintech today are bolting a chatbot onto a screen. You will own a fleet of agents that touch every function, every customer surface, and every employee workflow.
 



  





 You will design what the industry copies in 2027\. Composing agents through a shared mesh is not a pattern anyone in Indian fintech has shipped yet. You are not optimizing within a known design space. You are defining it.
 



  





 You will work next to a peer who matches your bar. The Director of Engineering (AI) will be hired on the same filter and will sit one seat away from you.
 



  





 It is a regulated environment, and that is a feature. Jupiter operates through two RBI\-regulated entities. Compliance shapes what your agents can do, and the constraint is what makes the moat defensible.
 



  





**What you’ll own** 




 The customer\-facing agent. Voice, scope, grounding rules, tool roadmap, audit cadence, and the policy layer that decides what the agent will never say.
 



 The internal agent fleet. You will expand the catalog and decide which function gets a peer next.
 



 The feedback\-to\-fix loop. Today it fires within hours of a thumbs\-down. You inherit it, tighten it, and turn it into the discipline the entire AI org runs on.
 



 The composition layer. You decide which agent should know what, which should call which, and where the human stays in the loop.The next surface. Customer\-side, employee\-side, partner\-side. You will sequence and ship it.
 



  





**What we’re looking for, beyond the qualifying filter** 




 Engineering\-grade debugging. When something is wrong with the bot, you read logs, trace the tool call, check the grounding source, write a regression test. You do not ask the team to “look into it.” Voice and judgment. You can hold a strong opinion on whether a single sentence in an agent reply is honest or evasive, useful or condescending. You will be the final taste arbiter for what millions of customers hear from Jupiter.

jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE:** 




 Aviatrix® is pioneering the Cloud Native Security Fabric — the architecture the Containment Era requires. The Cloud Native Security Fabric governs every workload communication path across every cloud, every VPC, every Kubernetes cluster, and every serverless function, from a single policy plane. One rule. Universal propagation. Enforced at the workload, not at a chokepoint. Trusted by more than 500 of the world's leading enterprises. For more information, visit aviatrix.ai.
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE: Principal Product Manager** 




 As a Principal Product Manager at Aviatrix, you will serve as a recognized subject matter expert and thought leader, owning the strategy and long\-term vision for a set of interrelated features and solution areas within our multi\-cloud networking platform. You will drive significant initiatives that shape product value and market differentiation, influencing the product roadmap at the leadership level.
 



 Working closely with engineering, marketing, sales, and customers, you will identify emerging opportunities, make high\-stakes prioritization decisions, and lead cross\-functional collaboration that defines Aviatrix's competitive position across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and beyond.
 



**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Own and drive the long\-term vision and comprehensive strategy for a set of interrelated features and solution areas, aligning them to the product's strategic goals, market position, and overall company vision.
* Influence the product roadmap at the leadership level by identifying future opportunities based on emerging industry trends, evolving user needs, and the competitive landscape.
* Engage regularly with enterprise customers, many of whom are based in the U.S., participating in product discussions, roadmap reviews, and strategic sessions; flexibility to schedule and attend meetings across time zones is expected.
* Establish prioritization frameworks for interdependent features that are adopted across product teams, and communicate rationale clearly to executive stakeholders.
* Make critical, high\-stakes decisions on feature scope and strategic direction, balancing cross\-functional input, market insights, and risk assessment to drive outcomes that impact the broader Product Management function.
* Lead execution across multiple interrelated features, overseeing project roadmaps, assigning responsibilities across teams, and establishing standards for quality delivery.
* Anticipate execution risks and adapt plans proactively based on resource or market changes, ensuring smooth cross\-functional collaboration.
* Maintain deep customer focus by synthesizing feedback and real\-world enterprise challenges into strategic product decisions, ensuring Aviatrix solutions address critical pain points at scale.
* Conduct competitive analysis and market research to keep Aviatrix at the forefront of enterprise cloud networking and security.
* Drive strategic\-level communication across functions, providing detailed roadmap updates, vision presentations, and reports to leadership and executive teams.
* Partner with ecosystem partners and internal teams to validate strategy and deliver measurable, impactful results.
* Evangelize Aviatrix's solutions as an internal and external subject matter expert through thought leadership, technical white papers, webinars, and speaking engagements.
* Mentor and develop junior product managers on execution, collaboration, and strategic thinking best practices.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience; Master's degree preferred.
* 12\+ years of experience in product management within the cloud or networking domain, with a demonstrated track record of driving product strategy at scale (or 8\+ years with a Master's degree).
* Broad expertise and deep specialization in cloud networking technologies, including VPN, SDN, SD\-WAN, firewalls, routing protocols, TCP/IP, DNS, IPSec, and cloud\-native networking across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Proven experience leading strategy and execution for a set of interrelated features or product areas, with direct influence on long\-term product roadmap and business outcomes.
* Experience with multi\-cloud architectures, networking protocols, and infrastructure as code (IaC) tools.
* Hands\-on experience with at least two major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS Networking, Azure Networking, Google Cloud Networking).
* Recognized ability to lead cross\-functional collaboration, build consensus, and influence stakeholders up to the executive level.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into strategic narratives for diverse audiences, including C\-suite.
* Experience mentoring and developing junior product managers.
* Willingness and ability to work flexible hours to accommodate meetings with customers and stakeholders based in the U.S. and other global time zones.

This is the first PM hire in NIRA’s current team.
   

  

 India's financial infrastructure spanning Account Aggregator, Credit Line on UPI, the Unified Lending Interface is advancing faster than anywhere in the world. UPI registers nearly a billion transactions a day. You’ll be building a product on top of infrastructure that doesn’t exist at this scale anywhere else, and the window to shape how it’s used in lending is right now.
   

  

 As part of a small, high\-ownership team on the ground in Bangalore, you will be part of an international product and leadership network with direct accountability for outcomes that matter.

* Resource\-constraint native: You cut scope to preserve core intent \- optimising for low bandwidth, not more headcount.

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Cisco Networking Group**
**Meet the team**
 Cisco's Networking (CN) organization is one that builds on the wonderful history of Cisco inventing and leading the global networking industry. The opportunity in front of all of us is unbelievable. Networks around the globe have been growing for over 35 years, and we are still at the beginning! It’s hard to imagine that three billion of the world’s eight billion people are still unconnected or underserved. Soon enough, we will move from billions of connected things and people to trillions of connected things and people. With the rise of the public cloud, connectivity is no longer simply physical access but includes virtual connectivity. And all this connectivity is central to every experience and every economy around the world. Cisco has been synonymous with connectivity for the last 35 years, and we are excited about creating the next era of connectivity with you.
   

  

 One of the things that stands out to me is the amount of amazing innovation and passion in every single team. We build great products with employees who have a deep passion for winning and want to help our customers solve their greatest connectivity challenges.
   

  

 Cisco has always had great innovation, but in the past this innovation and our potential have often been hindered by organizational and product silos. By bringing our teams closer, centralizing and synchronizing our operations, we will accelerate innovation to enable our customers to simplify everything! Central Operations is a new business unit within Cisco’s Networking organization who has been tasked to centralizing our practices as a service across. Our mission is to transform Cisco’s operational efficiencies by using real time data and insights and synchronized business processes to drive business decisions and accelerate the delivery of our strategic agendas. This will enable our vision, which is to increase both the human and cost efficiencies within Cisco, that will enable faster execution of our employees as well as free up capital that will allow us to afford resources earlier than would have been expected. The result is increased Operational Leverage generated by increased operating income, profit, and revenues for Cisco. You would be joining the Networking team, and the Central Operations organization to fulfill this mission and vision.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a Business Analyst, you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end management of processes surrounding the commitment of funds within Cisco. You’ll need to understand the policies within Cisco which instruct and require certain aspects of the funding request to be fulfilled and execute to those policies. You will also be responsible for entering each funding request, following them through the approval process, and helping to answer any questions or modify the entry as required. This general approach to managing the commitment of funds extends to our cross\-charge functions, as well as our accrual processes. With this responsibility, you will be working intimately with our Business Units across CN and with our partner organizations such as Finance, and Procurement – GSM and GPS \& Security Compliance orgs. We are looking for an experienced order fulfillment individual to drive more effective funds commitment and management processes within the business. When there is a roadblock working with other partner organizations, it’s your job to assist. We fulfill each above function by working within our own internally developed Business Operations Command Center Toolset while providing our organization the necessary training, documented procedures, operations, and tools to succeed. You would support many of these activities in support of your team.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 We are looking for someone who understands the purchasing systems and policies necessary to fulfil purchasing commitments with ease. Someone who makes perfect sense out of every field in SmartBuy, iProcurement, FinABC, GPE/BATS, Fieldglass, CCW and other purchasing and cross charge systems. You have been doing this for years, and desire to begin working more closely with the business units.
   

  

 We need you if you have a strong interest and experience in business operational practices and can assist in executing processes in a uniform fashion across CN. The processes and systems you will be maintaining will report and analyze intelligence metrics that will set, monitor, and drive improved financial results across CN. It is imperative that the information we enter and the contracts we submit for funding approval be aligned to policy. It’s our job to create efficiencies through quality work products. You will be responsible for reviewing, learning, maintaining, implementing, and improving systems and processes that help the organization scale and run more efficiently. You are a self\-starter; able to create a look forward and clear potential issues before they become roadblocks.
   

  

 You achieve success through strong cross\-functional relationships, engaging coworkers, and stakeholders to jointly design and deliver what an individual team could not. You also have a great passion for quality in your execution, you have great attention to detail, and you focus easily to drive tactical tasks to completion. You understand the needs of your cross\-functional stakeholders and customers. You measure success in the impact of your programs and breadth of cross\-functional contribution. This role is highly collaborative with tactical daily requirements. We will work with many organizations to deliver value to our business unit as well as across the Cisco Enterprise Networking group.
   

  

 You should have a strong understanding of Cisco systems used to execute our Procurement process, a general understanding of budget management, a tenacious desire to help people become more efficient. You value tactical and operational duties and have no issues spending cycles perform…

**About The Role**
 In this role, your key business responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Translate business requirements into effective data mapping solutions
* Develop sophisticated data transformation processes using ETL, Python, SQL, and other tools to deliver high\-quality data for Life \& Health stakeholders
* Design and execute test cases to validate data transformations, resolving discrepancies to ensure data integrity
* Perform rigorous data quality checks to ensure reliable data ingestion and consumption
* Analyze large, complex datasets to identify trends and support strategic business decisions
* Recommend and implement solutions for business challenges, including process improvements, system enhancements, or user training
* Serve as a liaison between business stakeholders and data experts, leading data\-driven projects
* Conduct ad hoc analyses to address specific business questions or support new initiatives
* Collaborate with peers to apply advanced analytics and automate smart business decisions


**About The Team**
 The Data Management \& Insights \[DMI] team is part of Business Excellence delivering on the promise of a stable end\-to\-end operating platform for Life \& Health Reinsurance \[L\&H Re]. Their mission is to make client data accessible to stakeholders by systematically acquiring and ingesting it. The team utilizes advanced analytics techniques to generate valuable insights for L\&H Re. With a continuous improvement mindset, they strive to enhance data, systems, and processes for both their own use and their stakeholders.
   

  

**About You**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science with 5\+ years of relevant experience in US Corporation (outside of internships and school projects)
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to present complex data and insights clearly to stakeholders
* Strong skills in data mapping, ETL processing, and data integration
* Proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience working with relational databases
* Experience working with large volumes of structured and unstructured data
* Familiarity with best practices of data management and governance
* Proven strategic, analytical, and conceptual thinking abilities
* Effective communication skills, with the ability to present complex data and insights to stakeholders clearly and concisely


**These Are Additional Nice To Have**
* Experience with large language models (LLMs) and AI\-assisted analytics for insight generation
* Data visualization skills and experience with tools like Tableau or Power BI
* Knowledge of Life \& Health Reinsurance
* Experience with agile methodologies and project management


**About Swiss Re**
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance\-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property \& Casualty and Life \& Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting\-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
   

  

 Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.
   

  

 If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
   

  

 We may use AI\-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.
